query:
SELECT state_code, status, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, primary_winner, pct_reporting FROM senate_races WHERE primary_date LIKE '%May 19%' OR primary_date LIKE '%May 20%' ORDER BY state_code;
SELECT state_code, district, status, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, primary_winner, pct_reporting FROM house_races WHERE (primary_date LIKE '%May 19%' OR primary_date LIKE '%May 20%') AND (candidate2_name IS NULL OR status = 'General') ORDER BY state_code, district LIMIT 20;
